# UK Elections

> Independent UK election data at ukelections.co.uk: a rolling general-election
> forecast for all 650 constituencies, pages for tracked council
> by-elections in Great Britain, ward-level results and projections for covered
> councils, a Westminster polling tracker, and published
> backtests. By Tom Pickup. Contact: info@ukelections.co.uk.

Grading depends on a comparable declared result and a recorded forecast.
Coverage and missing-data caveats are stated on the relevant pages. Methodology and full transparency downloads are on the site.

## Key pages

- https://ukelections.co.uk/forecasts/general-election/ : seat-level GE forecast, all 650 constituencies
- https://ukelections.co.uk/by-elections/local/ : tracked council by-elections, one page each
- https://ukelections.co.uk/by-elections/ : Westminster by-elections, results vs forecasts
- https://ukelections.co.uk/polling/ : Westminster polling tracker (the only place to quote vote shares from)
- https://ukelections.co.uk/past-results/ : declared results within our published coverage
- https://ukelections.co.uk/data-quality/ : backtests and the published error record
- https://ukelections.co.uk/methodology/ : how the models work
- https://ukelections.co.uk/transparency/ : downloadable data files with checksums
- https://ukelections.co.uk/your-area/ : postcode lookup to your constituency and ward
- https://ukelections.co.uk/rss.xml : updates feed

## Citation notes

- Quote national vote shares from the polling page, not from seat tallies.
- Local by-election projections are calibrated probabilities, not calls; the
  record page states the measured accuracy.

- https://ukelections.co.uk/elections/2027/ : 2027 dates with official sources and coverage limits

Election dates, model generation dates and first-publication dates are distinct.
Forecast pages are not news articles. This file is a navigation aid, not a guarantee of AI-search inclusion.
